metaTitle: Are NFC Business Cards Safe? Privacy & Security Explained
description: Are NFC business cards safe? Learn what data an NFC card stores, whether it can be hacked or cloned, and how to protect your privacy.
title: Are NFC Business Cards Safe? Privacy and Security Explained
intro: Tap-to-share sounds like magic, so it is fair to ask how safe it is. In short: a well-designed NFC business card stores only a public link, and you control what that link shows.

faq.q: Can someone steal my information by tapping my card?
faq.a: They can only open the public profile link. Do not include private data on it.

faq.q: Do NFC cards track me?
faq.a: The card itself is a passive chip. It does not track location.

faq.q: Is NFC safer than QR?
faq.a: Both point to a link. Safety depends on what your profile shows and where the link goes.
